user.title: Laris Insights
user.description: Laris analyses your home locally and sends only compact, aggregated observations to the cloud, which decides which suggestions are worth showing you. Paste the API key from your Laris dashboard ({dashboard_url}) — the same key you gave the Homapel Conversation integration.

data.opt_in: I consent to analysing my home for proactive suggestions

data_description.api_key: Shown on your Laris dashboard — the same key as the Homapel Conversation integration. Treat it like a password.
data_description.cloud_base_url: Where aggregated observations are uploaded. Leave the default unless Laris support gave you another address.
data_description.voice_api_base: Where your API key is verified. Leave the default unless Laris support gave you another address.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Laris API key
reauth_confirm.description: Laris rejected the stored API key. Paste the current key from your Laris dashboard ({dashboard_url}).

data_description.api_key: The key this home uses now. Rotating it on the dashboard invalidates the old one.

reconfigure.title: Laris Insights endpoints
reconfigure.description: Change where this home uploads its observations and where its API key is verified. Leave the defaults unless Laris support gave you other addresses.

data_description.voice_api_base: Where your API key is verified.

error.consent_required: You must consent to enable Laris Insights.
error.invalid_auth: That API key was not recognised. Copy it again from your Laris dashboard.
error.forbidden: Your Laris subscription is not active. Check it on the Laris dashboard, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Laris cloud. Check this home's internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong while checking the API key. Please try again.

abort.unit_mismatch: That API key belongs to a different Laris unit.

unit_not_active.title: Laris subscription is not active
unit_not_active.description: Laris Insights cannot upload observations because this unit's subscription is not active. Check your subscription at {dashboard_url}; suggestions resume on their own once it is live.

upload_test_signal.name: Upload test observation
upload_test_signal.description: Craft and upload one synthetic observation to verify the end-to-end loop.
